notes: No fact behind it, and no restated recommendation (rules 12, 13).

responses.value: Add dog training before opening new cities. 45% of current customers say they'd book training through the app, and each session earns us $25 against $8 for pet-sitting, with none of the $500,000 per-city launch cost. The main risk is that vetting takes 3 weeks per trainer, which slows the start. The next step is to vet 20 trainers in our busiest city and launch training there first.
I'd change the app's logo to attract more users.
